subject.title: fix(repair): publish only validated target commits

question: May credential-bearing repair publication rely on Linux user namespaces and Landlock while the acknowledged metadata, package-manager, network, Git, object-store, runtime-root, and gitlink surfaces remain unresolved?
rationale: This determines the trusted-computing boundary and supported runner contract; automated tests can validate an implementation but cannot choose which residual host and target capabilities maintainers accept.

options.title: Complete the boundary
options.body: Keep the draft open and contain or fail closed on every acknowledged residual surface before enabling credential-bearing publication.

options.title: Land a narrower subset
options.body: Split out immutable commit identity and isolated Git plumbing while leaving target validation non-credentialed until containment is complete.

options.title: Accept residual risk
options.body: Approve the Linux and Landlock contract with explicit operator requirements and documented residual metadata, network, hook, and Git risks.

recommendation.title: Complete the boundary
recommendation.body: Keep the draft open and contain or fail closed on every acknowledged residual surface before enabling credential-bearing publication.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc authored the current security model and has the strongest context for separating implementation gaps from intentional trust assumptions.
